scope_notes: This portable summary accompanies the source checkpoint. Full host-project logs and Player binaries are not included in this package.
Editor A/B image comparisons establish effect behavior; standalone smoke checks establish runtime nodes, scene pixels and recorded diagnostics.

Basic Mono, Shader Graph IL2CPP and the Forward feature build precede the compute-only screen-shadow explicit-LOD fix. Their fragment branch is unchanged; targeted compute, Advanced07 and subsequent feature builds cover the fix.
The first Deferred build is rejected despite exit 0 because shader compilation errors were present. Only the replacement build is accepted.
The four accepted feature-build logs contain zero shader-error lines and 129099 repeated shader-warning lines; see Validation.md for categories.
JobGraphProcessor is synchronous. XR, Unity 6 native GPU Resident Drawer and other unsupported paths listed in Validation.md are outside acceptance.
Camera stacking and MSAA are tested independently. Screen-space shadow coverage is compilation only.
